identity_lookup.name: verify_granted_identity
identity_lookup.description: Look up the current session token to learn which entity, policies, and metadata Vault bound to the authenticated session.

response_fields.data.id: Vault token ID for the current session
response_fields.data.accessor: Token accessor for correlation and revocation
response_fields.data.entity_id: Identity entity ID bound to the session
response_fields.data.meta: Auth metadata copied onto the token
response_fields.data.path: Auth path used to create the token
response_fields.data.renewable: Whether the token can be renewed

permission_check.name: verify_token_capabilities_self
permission_check.description: Ask Vault which capabilities the current session token has on specific paths to verify authorization binding.

request_body.paths: list of Vault paths to evaluate

response_fields.capabilities: Capabilities for a single queried path
response_fields.*.[]: Per-path capability list in the response object

permission_check.name: verify_token_capabilities
permission_check.description: Admin-side capability check for an arbitrary token to compare granted permissions across sessions.

request_body.paths: list of Vault paths to evaluate

response_fields.capabilities: Capabilities for a single queried path
response_fields.*.[]: Per-path capability list in the response object

access_test.name: verify_read_secret_kv1
access_test.description: Attempt to read a KV v1 secret using the authenticated session token.

response_fields.data: Returned secret data if access is allowed
response_fields.lease_duration: Advisory TTL on the secret response

access_test.name: verify_read_secret_kv2
access_test.description: Attempt to read a KV v2 secret using the authenticated session token.

response_fields.data.data: Returned secret payload if access is allowed
response_fields.data.metadata.custom_metadata: Key metadata visible with the read

session_token_inspect.name: inspect_session_by_accessor
session_token_inspect.description: Admin lookup of a token by accessor to inspect TTL, issue time, entity binding, and policy state without exposing the token ID.

request_body.accessor: token accessor from login response auth.accessor

response_fields.data.path: Auth path that created the token

session_token_inspect.name: renew_session_self
session_token_inspect.description: Renew the current session token to observe renewal behavior and lease extension limits.

admin_audit.name: verify_entity_details
admin_audit.description: Read the full identity entity record to inspect aliases, group memberships, and attached policies after authentication.

path_params.id: from login response auth.entity_id or token lookup data.entity_id

response_fields.data.name: Entity name
response_fields.data.policies: Policies attached directly to the entity
response_fields.data.aliases: Aliases linked to the entity across auth mounts

admin_audit.name: lookup_entity_by_alias
admin_audit.description: Resolve an alias name plus mount accessor to the canonical entity to detect cross-user or cross-mount identity collisions.

request_body.alias_name: external alias name such as JWT user_claim value
request_body.alias_mount_accessor: mount accessor from sys/auth for the tested auth mount

response_fields.data.name: Resolved entity name
response_fields.data.aliases: Aliases attached to the resolved entity

admin_audit.name: read_role_config
admin_audit.description: Read the configured JWT/OIDC role to confirm the exact constraints and grants under test.

admin_audit.name: verify_group_details
admin_audit.description: Read an identity group to inspect policies and membership that may have been reached through JWT group aliases.

path_params.id: group ID from entity lookup group_ids/direct_group_ids
